blocks.title: Alkenes
blocks.text: Alkenes unsaturated hydrocarbons hain: sirf hydrogen aur carbon ke compounds jin ke molecules mein carbon-carbon double bonds hon (alkynes mein triple bonds). Alkenes mein mutabiq saturated hydrocarbons se do hydrogen atoms kam hain, aam formula CnH2n.
Agle topics alkenes ke IUPAC naam (11.6.1), elimination reactions se un ki tayyari (11.6.2) aur un ki physical khusoosiyat dete hain.

blocks.prompt: Alkene mein utne hi carbons wale alkane se do hydrogens kam kyun hain?
blocks.explanation: Carbon-carbon double bond banane mein dono carbons par ek ek bonding jagah istemal hoti hai jo alkane mein hydrogen atoms ke paas thi, to CnH2n+2 CnH2n ban jata hai: ethane C2H6 aur ethene C2H4.

items: Alkenes: C=C wale unsaturated hydrocarbons, CnH2n, alkane se do H kam.
